turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero was entered before anyone called me, so start with who decided that.
We haven't started, Hale. It's 4:15 and my call isn't until 4:40. Who entered that zero, and on what basis?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?

Nothing is resolved, and I won't hand you a word to write up as if it were. I'm writing down that you asked me for it. The zero comes off Owen's grade, you apologise, and if you can't do that, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
I've answered that, Hale. You haven't told me who decided on the zero, or whether anyone spoke to Owen first. Answer that, or I'm going upstairs.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
"I need you to say okay." That's the third time, and it's not an answer to anything I asked. What do you have, Hale, besides a gradebook entry?
